title: Wisdom Calls Out in the Square
description: The first chapter of Proverbs begins with the purpose of the book and states that fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge. Then there is a warning against following sinners, before wisdom is personified as a woman who cries out loudly in the streets and at the city gates, calling the inexperienced to repentance.

versions.title: Wisdom Calls Out in the Square
versions.description: In the Book of Proverbs, wisdom is personified as a woman who proclaims her message in the square and invites everyone to seek insight. Fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge.
versions.reason: [minor] references: Chapter 1 contains several distinct parts: an introduction to the proverbs (1-7), a warning against sinners (8-19), and wisdom calling out (20-33). The title focuses on the latter, but the reference covers the entire chapter. This is still acceptable as a whole.; [minor] slug: The slug 'ordsprakene-om-visdom' is broader than the title suggests. 'visdommen-roper-pa-torget' would have matched the title better.
